title: One-hot selector encoding
statement: Let $S$ be a finite type and let $k$ be a natural number. The encoding of a selector from $\mathrm{TabSel}(S,k)$ is the Boolean vector indexed by the $|\mathrm{TabSel}(S,k)|$ positions that is true exactly at the position corresponding to that selector and false elsewhere.
